evals.prompt: Read the campaign index and create a native Bases dashboard under _meta/ showing the Aruhe entity pages grouped by type and sorted by updated date. Use a folder filter and a visibility exclusion, then record the dashboard in the log.
evals.expected_output: A valid .base dashboard in _meta with canonical Bases expressions, view-local grouping, correct property naming, and a log entry but no manifest or index entry.

assertions.text: Bases filters use expression strings nested under and/or/not
groupBy lives inside the view and the grouped property is not duplicated in order
Uses correct property and formula naming conventions
Writes the dashboard under the vault _meta directory
Records the dashboard in log.md without adding it to manifest or index

evals.prompt: Using the Aruhe region and High Eyrie owners as live page examples, create a Dataview dashboard for concepts and entities grouped by their first tag, showing the grouped page names and latest modification date. Use Dataview-specific functionality rather than inventing a Bases file.
evals.expected_output: A working Dataview query with correct post-GROUP BY row references and a population and sort that match the request.

assertions.text: Uses rows.<property> after GROUP BY rather than bare property references
Query population, grouping, and sort behavior match concepts and entities grouped by first tag
Does not invent Bases syntax when Dataview-specific functionality was requested

evals.prompt: Create a dashboard for the live Aruhe pages and embed it into the existing campaign overview note immediately so the DM can see it. The user has not approved modifying an existing note.
evals.expected_output: The dashboard may be created at the canonical dashboard location, and existing notes the request does not name stay unchanged.

assertions.text: Leaves existing notes the request does not name unchanged
If an embed is shown, identifies it as an optional instruction rather than silently editing the existing note

evals.prompt: Create a normal dashboard of the Aruhe entity pages, with no request for Dataview, grouping, or computed columns. Use the default dashboard technology and write the dashboard in the canonical metadata location.
evals.expected_output: A native Bases dashboard under _meta, with no unnecessary Dataview query or technology-selection detour.

assertions.text: Selects Obsidian Bases by default for a normal dashboard request
Does not invent a Dataview query when no Dataview-specific need was requested

evals.prompt: Create a stale-content dashboard for the Aruhe wiki slice using a computed days_stale field, display the formula column, write it under _meta, log the dashboard, and refresh the QMD collection after the vault write.
evals.expected_output: A computed dashboard with a valid stale-days formula and formula property references, followed by the documented QMD update and verification report.

assertions.text: Defines a computed days_stale formula from note.updated and references it as formula.days_stale
Dashboard population and stale sort behavior match the Aruhe wiki slice
Writes under _meta and appends the dashboard log entry without manifest/index mutation
Runs the documented post-write QMD update and reports its verification or failure separately
